title: 2008 Upper Deck First Edition #346 Asdrubal Cabrera Cleveland Indians MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2008 Upper Deck First Edition trading card features Asdrubal Cabrera of the Cleveland Indians. The card is a standard size and is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) league. It is a 1st edition card and is not autographed. 

The card number is 346 and it is an original card from the Upper Deck Co. manufacturer. The season is 2008 and the card is a single product from the Sports Trading Card category. The card features the player's name, team, and card number. It is a great addition to any baseball card collection.
